asked: # Build: "Add an axHub key" wizard (Hostinger first) on the console Wizards page ## Why The axHub `hostinger` service has no credential in the axHub vault, so every hostinger.* call fails with "credential not available". axHub has no UI or admin API for secrets yet (plan: axHub memory `plans/axhub-vault-management.md`). Today the only way is the Coolify terminal: `axhub services show <ns>` then `axhub vault set <credentialRef>`. Brett works from his phone and wants a guided wizard for this on the console's Wizards page. ## Find the Wizards page first Brett calls it "the wizards page". Find where the console lists wizards (check `apps/console-web/src/axf/core/catalog.ts`, `apps/console-web/src/axf/assets/toolbar/quick-create.json`, `apps/console-web/src/dialogs.tsx`, and `plugins/agent-manager/web/wizards.tsx` which has a WIZARDS registry + Shell stepper). If there is a shared Wizards page/registry, register the new wizard there. If wizards are only per-plugin, add it the same way the existing ones are registered so it shows wherever wizards are listed, and note in your report exactly where it appears. Do not invent a second wizards system. ## What to build A new console plugin `axhub-key-wizard` (or a wizard inside an existing fitting plugin if that's the house pattern) titled **"Add an axHub key"**, with a service picker whose first preset is **Hostinger**. Built from framework controls + assets (reuse the existing wizard Shell/stepper pattern; handwritten UI only if it conforms to the asset system). Steps (Hostinger preset): 1. **What this is** - one short paragraph: axHub keeps its own vault; this key lets Claude read your Hostinger account (plans, sites, SSL, billing). Read-only is enough. 2. **Get the token** - hPanel -> Profile (top right) -> API -> Generate/New token; name it `axhub`; pick the longest expiry you're comfortable with; copy it once (Hostinger shows it only once). Button: Open hPanel API page (`https://hpanel.hostinger.com/profile/api`). 3. **Find the key name** - Coolify -> axHub app -> Terminal -> run `axhub services show hostinger`, note `credentialRef`. Copy button for the command. Button to open Coolify (use COOLIFY_URL from the console credential store if set). 4. **Save it in the vault** - copy button for `axhub vault set <credentialRef>` (field to type the ref, prefilled if known); explain nothing shows while pasting, that's normal; then `axhub vault list` to confirm. Warn: never put the token on the command line. 5. **Also save in the console (optional)** - offer to store it as the console's HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN via the existing systems-check credential store (same masking/pattern rules from `apps/console-web/server/credentials.py`). Masked input, never echoed back, cleared after save. 6. **Test** - a Test button that, if the console has AXHUB_URL + AXHUB_TOKEN, calls axHub (`call` tool `hostinger.VPS_getVirtualMachinesV1` or the cheapest read-only hostinger op) and shows only ok / auth failed / credential missing / unreachable. Never show the response body. If the console has no axHub token, say so and link to Systems check. Make presets data-driven (a small JSON/asset list: service namespace, label, token page URL, help text, test op) so GitHub and others can be added later without code. Add GitHub as a second preset (test op `users/get-authenticated`). ## Hard rules - The wizard never sends a secret to axHub (there is no API for it yet) and never sends a secret to Claude/any MCP tool. - Secret values are never logged, echoed, stored in browser storage, or returned by any endpoint. Inputs: no autocomplete, cleared on submit. - Clean code, comments and commits (no slang). - Register in Directory/help@1 pack (screen intro) and follow plugin.json requirements like other plugins. - Tests for: preset loading, test-endpoint status mapping, secret never appears in responses/logs. ## Done when Wizard shows on the Wizards page, walks the Hostinger flow end to end on a phone-width screen, Test reports stat…
